buttons: Refresh queue (getByRole button name /Refresh queue|讀取中/)
fixture: spec 自動 POST /api/external/ifc-ready 兩筆 (default fixture, 非手動 curl): external_model_version_id='271_pieple_管線' (中文成功路徑) 與 'forcefail_demo' (哨兵, stub 強制回 400)
backend_real: 真打自起 coordinator (本 branch 碼) 的 POST /api/external/ifc-ready 與 GET /api/external/ifc-ready/:jobId, 前端 coordinatorClient.listIfcReady 走 same-origin GET /api/external/ifc-ready。conversion 端為 STUB (與真 SAFE_ID_RE 同規則)。
runtimeIds_note: 兩筆真實 ifc_ready_job_id (自 coordinator 回傳, 從 trace network 抽出)。一筆中文 id job → status=dispatched (dispatch_error null), 一筆 forcefail job → status=dispatch_failed (dispatch_error 含 400 + STUB forced failure)。

observed_states.loading: Refresh queue 按鈕 /Refresh queue|讀取中/ 涵蓋載入態
observed_states.success: 中文 id job 達 dispatched, conversion 欄=queued, 無 conv-dispatch-error 節點
observed_states.failure: forcefail job 達 dispatch_failed, dispatch 欄出現 conv-dispatch-error-<jobId> 節點, title 含 400
observed_states.retry: not observed — 重派/重試端點 (dispatch_failed re-dispatch) 非本 spec 目標 (spec §3)

assertions_passed: POST 中文 ifc-ready 回 202, jobId matches /^ifcready_/
中文 id job status === dispatched, dispatch_error === null
forcefail job status === dispatch_failed, dispatch_error contains '400'
table.ec-table visible 後 cjk row 可見, conversion td.nth(2) text === 'queued', 無 conv-dispatch-error-<cjkJobId> 節點
forcefail conv-dispatch-error-<failJobId> 節點 visible, title 屬性 match /400/
